title: ResultEnvelope
description: The uniform OUTPUT of every dmtool verb and every `apply` op (CLI-SPEC §3b): one op-record in, one envelope out, so an agent learns a single output shape. `ok` = the operation executed as asked; `valid` (validate/check) = the subject model is kernel-valid — distinct from `ok`. Optional keys (valid/changed/output) are omitted when not applicable.

target.description: the element family acted on: doc | rule | computation | field | group | typedef | include | config

op.description: the operation: add | read | modify | remove | validate | check | explain | describe | export | eval | compute | …

ok.description: the operation executed as asked (outcome in applied | preview | read | staged)

valid.description: validate/check (and after a mutating op): the subject model is kernel-valid — distinct from `ok`

summary.description: one human-readable line (the agent's quick read / log line)

changed.description: (mutations) the delta on success — e.g. {added, kind}, a refactor's rewritten references

data.description: (reads/queries) the op's payload — explanation tree, model card, fired-list, …; shape is op-specific (see `schema <target> <op>`)

written.description: whether the model was written to disk

output.description: the path the model was written to; absent for read/preview/refused/rejected
